missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative predicate. 'Предел' stays in the nominative as the predicate noun. 'Мой' and 'последний' are agreeing masculine modifiers describing the limit.
Strategic focus: Accusative object. 'Предел' is the accusative direct object of 'перешёл'. As an inanimate masculine noun, its accusative matches the nominative. 'Всякий' agrees in masculine.
Strategic focus: Nominative subject in possession frame. 'Предел' is the nominative subject of 'есть'. 'У моего терпения' shows whose limit it is, with the noun unchanged as subject.
Strategic focus: Genitive after preposition. 'Предела' takes the genitive after 'без' to express the lack of any boundary. The masculine genitive singular ends in -а.
Strategic focus: Dative after preposition. 'Пределу' takes the dative after 'к', showing approach toward the limit. The masculine dative singular ends in -у.
Strategic focus: Instrumental after verb. 'Пределом' takes the instrumental because 'гордиться' governs that case. The masculine instrumental singular ends in -ом. 'Своим' agrees.
Strategic focus: Prepositional of location. 'Пределе' takes the prepositional after 'на' in the idiom for being at one's limit. The masculine prepositional singular ends in -е.
Strategic focus: Instrumental plural after preposition. 'Пределами' takes the instrumental plural after 'за', the standard phrase for beyond the borders. The plural ends in -ами.
Strategic focus: Accusative plural. 'Пределы' is the accusative plural object of 'превзойти'. As an inanimate noun, the plural accusative matches the nominative plural in -ы.
Strategic focus: Genitive of possession. 'Предела' takes the genitive to link the achievement to the limit. 'Этого' agrees in the masculine genitive, ending in -ого.
